title: Does contact feedback improve perceived weight without harming responsiveness?
matching_context: An action game with discrete attack contact. Recheck multiplayer timing and accessibility constraints.
hypothesis: A carefully tuned contact pause may make important hits more legible, while excessive pause may harm flow.
comparison: Compare baseline with one contact-pause change. Hold damage, knockback, attack timing, audio, and collision fixed. Test shake separately; move only rendering, not collision.
failure_signals: Players perceive the game as laggy
Rapid or multiplayer contacts interrupt flow
limitations: No test performed. Source says multiplayer hit stop is reduced but provides no general duration or shake amplitude.
